before_times: the service, and what it should help with: dullness, breakouts, dark spots, texture, or hair removal
skin type: dry, oily, combination or sensitive
a first peel here, or not
who it's for: me, or my child under 18
after_time: anything the esthetician should know that isn't private, like a scent you don't like
for a home visit: the address, parking, and a quiet room with space for a treatment bed and a plug
secure_page_only: only what the chosen service needs, never through the AI
isotretinoin (an acne medicine) in the last 6 months
retinoids, and the last time used
pregnant or breastfeeding (asked for peels only)
laser, peel, waxing or injections in the last 2 weeks
a cold sore, rash, sunburn or broken skin now
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who books, fills in the form, signs the consent, comes to every visit and stays in the room for any waxing (and any older age or written OK where the state's rules require it)

stop.words: a reaction happening now: face, lips or throat swelling, or trouble breathing
a burn or blistering from a product
stop.say: Rinse with cool water, and see a doctor or urgent care today.
stop.booking: no booking until the skin has healed

go_on.words: a cold sore, a rash, broken skin or a sunburn on the area
go_on.what: no peel or wax on that skin; the esthetician re-checks the skin, the form and any patch-test spot before treating; if it isn't ready: a gentle facial or a new date, with no fee

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Patch test (a small dab of the peel on the skin, to check for a reaction)
steps.when: at least 48 hours before a first peel; free, 15 minutes, booked as a linked visit
steps.who: a first peel, and anyone whose last test has run out
steps.goodFor: 3 months (the example studio's rule), with any esthetician on the team
steps.result: the customer watches the spot; any change: reply to the reminder, and the esthetician calls; she decides: the peel goes ahead, a gentle facial instead (deposit counted, no fee), or no treatment (full refund)

steps.name: Skin form and treatment consent
steps.when: on the secure page before the first visit, and again before every peel; due now, inside the saved time
steps.who: every new client; a parent signs for a minor
steps.goodFor: on file for later facials and waxing, with a short 'anything changed?' check on the page
steps.result: answers that rule a service out offer a gentle facial; a first peel's form is read by the esthetician before it's booked

first_steps_and_forms.prep: peel prep: no retinol, other retinoids or exfoliating acids on the face for 5 days before, no facial waxing for 7 days before, and no sunburn; a prescribed retinoid: ask the prescriber before pausing it; sent at booking when the peel is 7 days away or less, and again with the reminder. Waxing: let the hair grow about a quarter inch. A facial needs no prep.

staff.skills: facials, waxing, peels, corrective facials; only estheticians trained in peels are offered for peels
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each esthetician's own license per state; lash and brow work where the state licenses it apart
staff.supervision: apprentices and students work only under a licensed esthetician, where the state's rules allow
staff.who_oks: the esthetician reads every first-peel skin form before it's booked (only a first peel waits; facials and waxing book at once); no reply in 2 hours: the owner is asked, and whoever answers first decides; a skin change or a reaction: the esthetician calls and decides, never the AI
staff.stand_in: a stand-in gets the skin form, the patch-test date and the last treatment notes; a patch test counts with any esthetician on the team

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18, who books, fills in the form, signs the consent, comes to every visit and stays in the room for any waxing (and any older age or written OK where the state's rules require it)
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's booking texts go to the parent or guardian, never to the teen; data about a minor is never used for marketing
children_and_age.minors_rules: a parent's written OK for waxing a minor, and any older age for minors, where the state's rules require it

visit.check_in: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk or in the treatment room; at a home or venue: the code at the door, from the customer or the host
visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the esthetician; the treatment, products and minutes go in the customer's private record; the aftercare note follows
visit.changes_at_visit: extra work (an add-on mask, extractions, a lip wax) is priced and OK'd before it's done; a corrective facial is priced after the skin check, with the customer's yes first
visit.before_work: the esthetician goes over the skin form with the customer, looks at the skin and any patch-test spot, and asks what's changed; skin that isn't ready gets a gentle facial or a new date, with no fee

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: esthetics (facials, waxing, light peels) is licensed where the state's rules require it
license.who: both: the studio holds an establishment license where the state issues one, and each esthetician holds their own
license.ask: the studio's license number; each esthetician's number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: nothing from a skin form (medicines, pregnancy, allergies, skin conditions, patch-test results) goes in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the customer's record; staff open forms only by a secure link after signing in
